payload.reason: The evidence describes how the IPA system labels data after interacting with users by using a rule-based system to automatically label user inputs with corresponding next actions and dialogue IDs, without requiring additional post-labeling.

claims.text: The IPA system labels user inputs automatically with corresponding next actions and dialogue IDs using a rule-based system.
No additional post-labeling is required for the IPA system after user interaction.
The system predicts the next action based on user input and predefined labels.
